worldcombat.skill.bodypress.summary: Drop your centre of gravity, brace your shoulder and take one short step forward, pressing everyone in the way back with the broad shoulder edge in front of your body. One pass presses at most 3 actual bodies, and the damage and shove are split among them. You can pick a direction and press into empty space. The higher your Defence, the harder it hits and the further it presses; a body that resists knockback still takes the damage but is not guaranteed to move.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.use.0: Press several foes crowding a narrow gap back at once
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.use.1: Hold one face of a fight with armour and weight
Deals about %1$s total press power, split among the bodies actually touched this pass, with a %2$s block shoulder-face depth; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Available after %1$s seconds of bracing; it steps out one third of its %2$s block drive budget (at most 1.2 blocks) at %3$s blocks per tick.

Every body in the shoulder face is shoved along the drive, about %1$s blocks total split among those actually touched, at most 3 a pass; targets move by native hit displacement, so a wall or a body that resists movement is not force-shoved, and the flanks and rear are outside the face.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.wide.on: Broad form: the shoulder line extends up to 0.3 blocks, making it easier to press several foes at once, but the total damage and shove are split among them so each takes less.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.wide.off: Narrow form: the shoulder line hugs your body, pressing only one or two adjacent foes, and each takes a larger share.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.growth.0: At level %1$s, the press power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.growth.1: At level %1$s, the press power rises to %2$s and the shove distance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.preference.w: On: the shoulder line extends up to 0.3 blocks and presses several foes at once, but the total damage and shove are split among them so each takes less. Off (narrow form): it hugs your body and presses only one or two adjacent foes, each taking a larger share.
worldcombat.skill.bodypress.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of pressing. Larger values chase harder, and are easier to kite before the press lands.
Below this fraction of health it will not start a press unless the target is nearly finished. Higher values are more protective and press less while low.
